prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Monochrome Signal: page #FFFFFF, text #111111, accent #494949, secondary surface #E8E8E8, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Oswald and reading text in Work Sans; condensed heading with open sans text. Composition: Three-column product grid, consistent image ratios, filter rail, one-column mobile. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 48px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
